name: Évora
mandate: PrompTugal.news Évora: AI and technology in Évora, a university city in the Alentejo whose centre of gravity is the Universidade de Évora, the PACT science park and the public hospital, and what reaches Évora from the Alentejo, Portugal and the world. Independent. Every fact sourced.

gravity.text: Évora's AI activity sits in three places. The Universidade de Évora teaches an AI and data science degree, has written its own rules for AI in teaching and says it has built Portuguese-language models. PACT, the Alentejo science and technology park, runs AI training and hosts technology firms. The Hospital de Évora is the first Portuguese public hospital to use an AI system for cervical screening, by its health unit's own account. Newer private money has also arrived, with a data centre company buying a 1 MW site in the city. The council's own site shows no AI use that we could read, so the university, the park and the hospital, not city hall, are the centre of gravity.

ai_news.title: Évora's new Confucius Institute lists AI among future joint work with China
ai_news.summary: At the 16 October 2026 opening of the Confucius Institute at the Universidade de Évora, the rector named AI, data science and agrifood as areas of existing and planned cooperation, with ideas such as AI for cultural heritage, health, environment and agriculture.
ai_news.ai_path: A language and culture institute in Évora whose opening speech names AI as a planned area of cooperation with Chinese universities: two steps from AI. The AI projects are proposals, not announced work.

ai_news.title: Data centre firm NxN buys a 1 MW site in Évora
ai_news.summary: NxN Data Centers bought an operating data centre in Évora, its first asset in Portugal, and plans to invest up to 100 million euros over three years. The company says it builds data centres designed for AI workloads. The source does not say what the Évora site runs.
ai_news.publisher: Portugal Global (AICEP), from Data Center Dynamics
ai_news.ai_path: A data centre in Évora owned by a company that builds for AI workloads: two steps from AI.

ai_news.title: Universidade de Évora says it has built Portuguese-language AI models
ai_news.summary: A professor of informatics told Lusa that the university's smaller, open Portuguese models reach performance comparable to big tech models on some tasks, and that a Portuguese and Galician model is already available to companies.
ai_news.ai_path: Évora's university builds language models: directly about AI. The date comes from the page address because the text shows none. The performance claim is the university's own.

ai_news.title: Hospital de Évora starts using AI in cervical cancer screening
ai_news.summary: The Alentejo Central health unit says its Évora hospital is the first Portuguese public institution to use a digital cytology system with AI that flags suspicious areas for specialists to review. It says the system supports and does not replace clinical judgement.
ai_news.ai_path: A public hospital in Évora uses an AI diagnostic system: directly about AI. The RTP page shows no date, so the date is taken from Lisboeta's report of 6 March 2026 that cites RTP. The first-in-Portugal claim is the health unit's own.

ai_news.title: Universidade de Évora sets a framework for AI in teaching and assessment
ai_news.summary: Despacho n.º 34/2026 asks teachers and students to be transparent about AI use, to declare it in coursework and to protect personal data. It followed a working group and 37 comments from the academic community and is to be reviewed after the second semester.
ai_news.ai_path: The university sets its own rules for AI use: directly about AI.

ai_news.title: PACT closes its AIRA project after training more than 500 people in AI for robotics
ai_news.summary: At a closing session in Portalegre, PACT said the EU-funded AIRA programme trained more than 500 people in applying AI to robotics. Three ideas won technology vouchers in its ideas contest, among them a system using computer vision and language models to automate stage lighting and an aircraft inspection system using computer vision.
ai_news.publisher: PACT (Parque do Alentejo de Ciência e Tecnologia)
ai_news.ai_path: A science park in Évora ran a funded AI in robotics course and ideas contest: directly about AI. The training figures and the winners are PACT's own account.

ai_map.name: Universidade de Évora (UÉ)
ai_map.what: Public university. Offers a bachelor's degree in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science (20 places for 2026/2027), published an AI framework for teaching on 6 February 2026 and says it has built Portuguese language models.

ai_map.name: Cátedra High Performance Computing (UÉ, funded by HPE)
ai_map.what: A university and industry chair for high-performance computing that also covers data science and AI, with partner universities and companies. The article we read dates from 2021.
ai_map.ai_path: Offers AI training and services alongside computing infrastructure. We did not confirm that it is active in 2026.

ai_map.name: Hospital de Évora (ULS Alentejo Central)
ai_map.what: The public hospital of the Alentejo Central health unit. Uses an AI-assisted digital cytology system for cervical screening.

ai_map.name: PACT: Parque do Alentejo de Ciência e Tecnologia
ai_map.what: Science and technology park in Évora. Led AIRA, a free online course of about 30 hours on AI in robotics with the University of Ljubljana, and published a certified 12-hour course on AI tools for company productivity (16 and 23 October, from a September 2025 notice).
ai_map.ai_path: Trains people and firms in AI.

ai_map.name: ELIO Tecnologia
ai_map.what: Luso-Brazilian company based at PACT, presented in October 2020 as a joint venture with the CEiiA technology centre. Offers precision services for farming, livestock and forestry with aerospace, robotics and AI technology. The page is from 2020, so its present activity is unconfirmed.
ai_map.ai_path: Names AI as part of its product.

ai_map.name: KPMG Portugal technology centre in Évora
ai_map.what: A technology office opened in September 2023 in the first of PACT's new buildings, planned to reach 100 jobs, with part of the team starting a project on AI including generative AI.
ai_map.ai_path: A consultancy's Évora team works on AI projects. The source is from 2023.

ai_map.name: NxN Data Centers (Évora site)
ai_map.what: Bought a 1 MW operating data centre in Évora in October 2026 and plans up to 100 million euros of investment in Portugal over three years.
ai_map.ai_path: Builds data centres designed for AI workloads. The source does not say the Évora site runs them.

ai_map.name: CCDR Alentejo
ai_map.what: The Alentejo regional development body. Its 2025 programme for training local administration included a full-day awareness session on AI in local government on 20 May 2025 at its Évora address.

ai_map.name: ROBO-KNOT (Horizon Europe project with PACT as a consortium member)
ai_map.what: A 12-partner, seven-country robotics project on research innovation and researcher mobility. PACT took part in its consortium meeting in Budapest on 8 September 2026. The page speaks of robotics and does not name AI.
ai_map.ai_path: A robotics research project joined by an Évora science park, and PACT's own robotics training is built on AI: two steps from AI. We found no AI claim in the project page itself.

ai_map.name: ÉvoraTech: technology-based business incubator (Município de Évora, run by ADRAL)
ai_map.what: A 705 square metre incubator for technology-based firms inside PACT, owned by the council and managed by ADRAL. It hosts a FabLab with digital fabrication tools. The pages do not mention AI.
ai_map.ai_path: The council's incubator for technology start-ups, any of which may build on AI: three steps from AI. No AI firm is named on the page.

gaps: No AI use by the Câmara Municipal de Évora in its own services turned up. Its news pages and site search gave us nothing on AI, its Dinâmica e Inovação and Balcão Empreendedor pages were under maintenance when we opened them, and a government pilot of AI in building licences names Coimbra and does not list Évora. We should look for council minutes, procurement notices on base.gov.pt and the full council news items.

We found no dated Évora AI event for the weeks ahead. PACT's agenda page loaded its list with scripts that our reader could not run, so upcoming events there are unchecked. The only event we confirmed, TEDxÉvora at PACT on 12 March 2026, has already happened and is not AI in itself. We should check PACT's agenda, the university's agenda and Alentejo regional press.

The SNS data centre planned for Évora by the end of 2026 (Lisboeta, 16 June 2026) is a public data centre with no AI stated in the article, so it is not on the map. If it hosts AI workloads, it becomes a map entry.

Startups are still thin. The only AI company we could place at PACT is ELIO Tecnologia, from a 2020 government page. PACT's pages name KPMG Portugal, Dectech and CEiiA among its companies but no further AI firm, and we found no Évora AI startup funding round in 2025 or 2026. Sources to look for: PACT's list of its 55 companies, Portugal Ventures and Banco de Fomento notices.

Could not open Data Center Dynamics and Agroportal (403), and read Despacho 34/2026 and CCDR's programme only as PDFs. We could not confirm the maker of the hospital's AI screening system. The Universidade de Évora's news list showed no dates and no AI items on the page we opened, so its news by date is still unread. The CHAT DIVE hackathon on ChatGPT health apps at PACT with the firm DECSIS (December 2023) is old and its firm's base was not stated, so it is not on the map.

Not reached: a Diário do Sul or Diário do Alentejo search for Évora AI stories, the Politécnico de Portalegre and CEiiA pages, and Évora AI research groups beyond what the university's degree and language-model news imply. No feeds found for any source.

The Alentejo Competitive Intelligence Center (NOVA IMS, Campo Maior) is a regional AI and data hub but is based in Campo Maior, so it belongs on another place's page. A May 2026 tender for a Rui Nabeiro Accelerator in Évora (ADRAL) was seen only in a search listing and has no AI link we could check.

The Universidade de Évora's executive course 'AI for Business' with Microsoft Portugal dates from 2022, the HPC chair article from 2021 and PACT's Master ChatGPT course from October 2024, so we treat them as background and could not confirm they are running.
Investors are thin: no venture fund or business angel network tied to Évora was found on a page we opened. The amounts for the EIT Deep Tech Talent grant behind AIRA are not on the pages we read.
Local talent is not filled: no source lists anyone and nobody has agreed to be listed here. PACT runs a Talent Pool of CVs open to its partner companies, which is not public.

Third pass, 17 Nov 2026: no Évora AI news dated after 16 November turned up in a web search or on PACT's news page (its newest item, a CarbonWise Forum, shows only NOV.2026 and no AI). PACT's feed at pact.pt/feed/ is valid RSS 2.0 (last built 13 November 2026) but held no items when read, so it is listed as a feed that is not yet useful. The council's news page returned only menu text in the first 200,000 characters of 442,727 and no dated AI item; the rest is unread. Gaps above otherwise stand unchanged.

Fourth pass, 20 Nov 2026: nothing new for the 18 to 20 Nov window. A Voz de Évora (feed read to 2 November; 18 to 20 Nov items are culture, sport, police and waste collection), Diário do Sul (10 items, 19 to 20 Nov, none on AI or technology) and PACT's news page (four November items, no day shown, none on AI) held no AI item. PACT's feed at pact.pt/feed/ is valid but still empty (last built 20 Nov 2026). The university's news page and the council's news were not reread.

voice.lede: Évora, ó pá: a city of whitewash, cork oaks and old stones where the machines are learning to speak Portuguese, slowly, calminha, as one does in the Alentejo.
voice.mandate: PrompTugal.news Évora, a nossa cidade branca do Alentejo: AI and tech in Évora, with the Universidade de Évora, the PACT park and the hospital doing the heavy lifting, plus whatever news rolls in from the Alentejo, Portugal and the world. Independente, and every fact comes with a receipt.
voice.gravity: Évora does not rush, but it gets there. The university teaches the machines Portuguese and writes the house rules for them, PACT trains the people and keeps the lights on for the firms, the hospital lets an AI point at the slide before a specialist decides, and a data centre company has quietly bought a 1 MW room. City hall, bless it, we could not catch doing AI yet.
voice.gaps_intro: Ainda falta muito, pá, e nós não temos pressa. Here is what Évora has not told us yet:

start_company.name: PACT incubation and cowork plans (inPACT physical, onPACT digital, cowork, premium)
start_company.what: PACT lists four ways to join its ecosystem: physical incubation with a dedicated room, digital incubation with a company address, a cowork desk, or a premium plan with company headquarters and one cowork space. The page shows no prices. It says the park holds 55 companies.

start_company.name: ÉvoraTech incubator (council-owned, run by ADRAL, inside PACT)
start_company.what: A 705 square metre incubator for technology-based and innovative firms in their early stages, with shared services and a FabLab for prototyping. The page was updated on 8 May 2024.

start_company.name: ADRAL: advice for entrepreneurs and the incubator network
start_company.what: The regional development agency says it supports entrepreneurs from idea to market, helps find funding and prepare applications, and runs a network of incubators with desks in the municipalities.

start_company.name: AlentEdge Office at PACT (intellectual property and business support)
start_company.what: PACT's office helps with trademarks, patents and design registration through a partner, with a 15 percent discount for PACT ecosystem members on that partner's fees, and offers certified training courses.

start_company.name: Universidade de Évora: start-ups and spin-offs
start_company.what: The university's innovation division says it promotes the creation of university start-ups and supports spin-offs from its research with coaching and funding. The page was last published with 2020 data.

start_company.name: Startup Portugal: national incubation network and founder guide
start_company.what: The national start-up agency's site lists the national incubator network, a founder's guide and programmes for entrepreneurs. We did not find an Évora-specific page on it.

start_company.name: Empresa na Hora (Instituto dos Registos e do Notariado, via ePortugal)
start_company.what: A national service at counters called Empresa na Hora to set up private limited companies, single-member companies and public limited companies quickly. Updated 4 September 2026 on ePortugal. The page does not list the Évora counter.

investors.name: EIT Deep Tech Talent (European Union) into PACT's AIRA project
investors.what: The AIRA course and ideas contest on AI in robotics was funded by the European Union through EIT Deep Tech Talent. PACT's projects page also lists AI Robotics Academy among its active projects. The amount is not stated on the pages we read.
investors.ai_path: Pays for AI in robotics training run in Évora: directly about AI.

investors.name: NxN Data Centers into an Évora data centre
investors.what: Bought a 1 MW operating data centre in Évora and plans up to 100 million euros of investment in Portugal over three years.
investors.amount: up to 100 million euros across Portugal over three years
investors.ai_path: A data centre company that builds for AI workloads: two steps from AI.

investors.name: Alentejo 2030, Horizon Europe, PRR and Interreg funds in PACT's projects
investors.what: PACT's projects page lists 15 active co-funded projects, such as ROBO-KNOT (Horizon Europe), Future Lab (Alentejo 2030) and CIRCULARTECH (PRR), and says the projects represent 16 million euros of investment. Only the AI in robotics project is clearly AI.
investors.amount: 16 million euros across all PACT projects, as PACT states
investors.ai_path: Regional and European programme money behind a science park that trains in AI: one step from AI.
